simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_synaps_2340_app_starts.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_synaps_2340_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1") runs with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200 and maincode(AV) ("20020A002340") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to "-ON-", initialises its userdb(64+64) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Impulse SAT (System ID 20020A00, Synaps v2.3.40 by Dekolte) firmware (2016-05-15) on a 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B receiver with 128 MB DDR3.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, and a CH455 4-digit LED / IR sensor eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA) (" ON " -> "-ON-").
